reason: Provides Langfuse-based observability for DeepSeek Harness sessions by exporting OpenTelemetry trace trees, feedback scores, and optional generation inputs to an external endpoint.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体会话、模型生成、工具调用和反馈以 OpenTelemetry 追踪形式导出到 Langfuse 进行可观测性分析。
summaries.en: Exports DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, model generations, tool calls, and feedback as OpenTelemetry traces to Langfuse for observability.

capabilities: Exports agent session telemetry to Langfuse via OpenTelemetry traces
Records model generations, tool calls, token usage, timing, errors, and feedback scores
Can optionally export generation inputs including prompts and tool schemas
Uses configured Langfuse credentials and sends data to a configured external endpoint
